title: Deleting or cancelling a return is controlled by Invoicing & payments Delete
custom_preconds:
1. Role A has Invoicing & payments Delete and Vendor and order management.
  2. Role B has Vendor and order management only (no Invoicing & payments Delete).

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as role A and open Parts > Returns.
Open the work-order-type return's action menu.
custom_steps_separated.expected: A Delete return option is shown.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the manual return's action menu.
custom_steps_separated.expected: A Cancel return option is shown.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as role B and open the work-order-type return's action menu.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Delete return option is not shown (role B lacks Invoicing & payments Delete).

viu_status: Blocked-UI: deleting/cancelling a return (gated by Invoicing Delete) needs a part return seeded first (create return via admin) then observe the delete/cancel gate; return flow not seeded this pass.
